steps.name: publish-phase1-stable-core
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED_BASE=c9040c4ecbcf08022fc3a6b5cab6ee0199d94571
git fetch origin main --tags
ACTUAL=$(git rev-parse origin/main)
test "$ACTUAL" = "$EXPECTED_BASE" || { echo "MAIN_MOVED expected=$EXPECTED_BASE actual=$ACTUAL"; exit 3; }
git reset --hard origin/main
git clean -fd
printf '%s' '' | base64 --decode > /tmp/tracker-phase1.patch
cat /tmp/tracker-phase1.patch >/dev/null
echo 'TASK_PAYLOAD_PLACEHOLDER'; exit 99
